title: Minimum probability of either sign
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite type with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f:(\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\Omega)\to\mathbb R$. The minimum sign probability is the smaller of the product probabilities that $f$ equals $1$ and that $f$ equals $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$f$ is a real-valued function on product inputs
